plainText:
Kato (Japanese: カンタ Kanta) is one of the two characters and meet in the beginning of Arceus and the Jewel of Life.

==In the movies==
Kato, along with Kiko, battled Ash and Dawn for their watermelons. Later, they advised Ash and his friends to see the ruins of their town. Later on, after Ash and his friends return from the corrected past, with subsequently recognizing Ash from the past events and restoring the destruction, Kato and Kiko were seen witnessing the regeneration of the bridge's structure. Kato and Kiko later made a brief appearance in the ending credits, where they are seen eating corn on the back of a tractor.
